dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle tip.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical indentation visible on the anterior-left lateral margin at the water interface; otherwise, edges appear smooth and continuous.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high-intensity reflectance; consistent tone across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse light-grey linear streaks scattered across the dorsal surface, particularly visible on the left side of the midline.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the faint pigmented streaks and the primary white baseline canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple faint, linear, low-contrast marks (surface scratches) visible across the central and lateral dorsal planes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of numerous shallow, linear epidermal scratches (rake marks) concentrated on the mid-dorsal section.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined, shadow-casting longitudinal dorsal ridge extending along the central axis toward the peduncle.
